reviewer: main coordinator; source-level cross-file comparison; no runtime execution
title: Reversed dashboard range normalizes headline query but produces an empty daily series
scope: Targeted edge-case extension to SEM-MIRROR-020 and existing FIN-CAND-REPORT-RANGE-001. Compares API range admission, shared range conversion/enumeration, sales headline query and dashboard daily-series aggregation. No AST clone claim; not a repository-wide semantic audit.
decision: SOURCE-CONFIRMED REPORT-CONSISTENCY DIVERGENCE FOR A REVERSED MULTI-DATE REQUEST: the endpoint accepts the constructed reversed BusinessDateRange; the headline query normalizes UTC endpoints by swapping them and reads the corresponding dates, while daily-series point enumeration uses the unnormalized From/To and returns no points. Policy on reject-versus-normalize is not specified. Cross-reference existing FIN-CAND-REPORT-RANGE-001; no new canonical finding ID.

observed_behavior.precondition: An actor passes reports access and requests owner-dashboard with from later than to; only a multi-day reversed range selects daily series.
observed_behavior.headline: ReportingQueryService uses BusinessDateRange.ToUtcRange; BusinessClock.UtcRangeForBusinessDates swaps reversed endpoints; noncancelled orders in the normalized interval are queried and summarized.
observed_behavior.series: OwnerDashboardQueryService selects LoadDailySeriesAsync because reversed distinct endpoints are not single-day; that method queries the same normalized interval but constructs output only from BusinessDateRange.Days(); Days iterates day=From while day<=To and thus yields no points.
observed_behavior.counterpart: For forward ranges the two formulas share order creation cohort, cancellation exclusion and TotalPiastres-RefundAmountPiastres; existing test verifies chart sum equals headline for forward seven-day range.

cross_file_call_chain: OwnerDashboard LoadTrendAsync -> ReportingQueryService.GetSalesReportAsync -> LoadSalesOrdersAsync -> normalized ToUtcRange
OwnerDashboard LoadTrendAsync -> LoadDailySeriesAsync -> normalized query + original-range Days() zero-point enumeration
counterevidence_and_limits: The API may receive only UI-validated ranges in normal use; the endpoint itself does not validate order and no client-specific input check was included in this bounded comparison.
The correct contract could reject reversed endpoints or normalize them; source does not document which.
Existing forward-range test supports intended reconciliation in normal requests but does not cover reversed inputs.
No integration test, HTTP request, database query, or runtime behavior was executed.
candidate_disposition: No duplicate finding. Extends FIN-CAND-REPORT-RANGE-001 to the dashboard headline/series pair; record as source-confirmed edge-case inconsistency pending common range-input policy and existing finding reconciliation.
recommendation: Choose one invariant at the API/domain boundary: reject From>To with a clear client error, or normalize BusinessDateRange endpoints once so ToUtcRange, DayCount, IsSingleDay and Days share the same canonical endpoints. Keep sales, expense, cost and dashboard series semantics aligned; avoid locally normalizing only one report.
required_tests: API integration request with reversed multi-day owner-dashboard endpoints: assert explicit validation error or consistently normalized headline and ordered daily points.
Unit/property test BusinessDateRange for From>To: ToUtcRange, DayCount, IsSingleDay and Days must agree with chosen invariant.
Cross-report reconciliation test for sales, expenses, costs and dashboard series under reversed input.
Forward single-day and forward multi-day regression tests remain unchanged.
limits: Static source review only; no tests executed.
No source, test, runtime or database changes.
This comparison does not establish broad semantic completeness.

source_references.evidence: Owner dashboard endpoint authorizes reports access, resolves (from,to,businessDate) into BusinessDateRange without rejecting From>To, and passes it to dashboard service.

UtcRangeForBusinessDates swaps reversed endpoints; BusinessDateRange.ToUtcRange delegates to it, while Days enumerates from original From to To with an ascending condition and so yields no dates for a reversed range.
Sales headline uses normalized ToUtcRange and excludes cancelled orders, materializing rows for shared SalesRules report calculation.
Multi-date range selects daily series; daily series queries using normalized range and then enumerates original range.Days() to build points.
Forward seven-day range test asserts seven points and series sum equals headline; no reversed endpoint case in the inspected test class.
